name: What factors determine the cost of custom trim installation?

mainEntity.name: What factors determine the cost of custom trim installation?

acceptedAnswer.text: Costs vary significantly based on linear footage, profile complexity, material choice, and wall condition. Basic MDF baseboards or casings cost less in materials and labor, while multi-piece crown molding, hardwood materials, or tall wainscoting require advanced finish carpentry techniques that raise costs. Working in rooms with uneven drywall or vaulted ceilings also adds labor time for custom scribing and fitting. HH Remodeling assesses these wall and ceiling alignments during the initial walkthrough to provide an accurate estimate covering carpentry, patching, and paint prep.
acceptedAnswer.description: Trim costs depend on linear footage, wood versus MDF materials, profile detail, ceiling height, and whether uneven walls require extra scribing or drywall repairs.
